      "statement_sha256": "84902cc4f7baa802ed8ffc794678275a2c87f07997efe1add5465de6a77ac514",
      "full_elaborated_statement": "\u2200 {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} D]\n  (catalog : DefiKernel.Composition.Catalog P A D) (state : DefiKernel.Typed.State P A D) (index : Nat)\n  (edges : List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding) (failure : DefiKernel.Interface.BindingFailure P A D),\n  Iff\n    (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Interface.BindingFailure P A D) PUnit.{1})\n      (@DefiKernel.Interface.checkEdgesFrom P A D inst inst_1 catalog state index edges)\n      (@Except.error.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Interface.BindingFailure P A D) PUnit.{1} failure))\n    (\u2203 before edge after,\n      And\n        (@Eq.{1} (List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding) edges\n          (@HAppend.hAppend.{0, 0, 0} (List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding) (List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding)\n            (List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding)\n            (@instHAppendOfAppend.{0} (List.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding)\n              (@List.instAppend.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding))\n            before (@List.cons.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding edge after)))\n        (And (@DefiKernel.Interface.Agrees P A D catalog before state)\n          (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Interface.BindingFailure P A D) PUnit.{1})\n            (@DefiKernel.Interface.checkEdge P A D inst inst_1 catalog edge state\n              (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) index\n                (@List.length.{0} DefiKernel.Interface.Binding before)))\n            (@Except.error.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Interface.BindingFailure P A D) PUnit.{1} failure))))"
    },

===== INPUT review/semantic-kernel/sprint10/mutations-r1/REPORT.md SHA256 cad12ef81a0d55c0250f232f75e7eb6fe6cfad49fa37933d0598a3910f6c2814 =====
All14 production runtime mutations compiled and were discriminated at `b165bc586080d668f689fbc18dfa09eb8739d688`. The unchanged control had99/99 true comparisons. Every variant emitted the identical complete unique inventory, its designated observation was false and both global positives remained true. Runner exit0.

These mutations change read-only Interface region/receipt/binding query computations. Financial fixtures execute the actual existing kernel; no mutation changes its executor, authority guards or transitions. Typed, structural and diagnostic checks are classified separately in summary.json. Only new Interface proof suffixes are stripped; imported old proofs remain exact.

| Mutation | Designated false | False count |
|---|---|---:|
| maximum-instead-of-sum | interface.region.sum | 11 |
| negated-receipt-delta | interface.region.transfer-out | 3 |
| first-repeated-target-only | interface.region.repeated | 1 |
| supply-masks-region-delta | interface.region.mint | 1 |
| whole-supply-as-region-delta | interface.region.transfer-out | 3 |
| drop-final-binding | interface.binding.unequal | 16 |
| compare-left-with-itself | interface.binding.unequal | 8 |
| omit-asset-comparison | interface.binding.asset | 1 |
| omit-domain-comparison | interface.binding.domain | 2 |
| global-port-lookup | interface.binding.unequal | 19 |
| missing-port-fallback | interface.binding.missing-port | 3 |

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem resolveExport_iff (registry : Registry P A D) (catalog : Catalog P A D)\n    (valid : validateCatalog registry catalog = true) (name : QualifiedPort) (cell : Cell P A D) :\n    resolveExport catalog name = .ok cell \u2194\n      \u2203 component \u2208 catalog, component.id = name.component \u2227\n        \u2203 port \u2208 component.exports, port.id = name.port \u2227 port.cell = cell",

          "source_sha256": "e170ec67737f94b111cfacb00bda9eae14826bb71f92d2199949634a88e8a8c0",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem distinct_exports_nonalias (registry : Registry P A D) (catalog : Catalog P A D)\n    (valid : validateCatalog registry catalog = true) (left right : QualifiedPort)\n    (leftCell rightCell : Cell P A D) (distinct : left \u2260 right)\n    (hl : resolveExport catalog left = .ok leftCell)\n    (hr : resolveExport catalog right = .ok rightCell) : leftCell \u2260 rightCell",

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem checkEdgesFrom_error_iff (catalog : Catalog P A D) (state : State P A D)\n    (index : Nat) (edges : List Binding) (failure : BindingFailure P A D) :\n    checkEdgesFrom catalog state index edges = .error failure \u2194\n      \u2203 before edge after, edges = before ++ edge :: after \u2227 Agrees catalog before state \u2227\n        checkEdge catalog edge state (index + before.length) = .error failure",

      "id": "GB11",
      "title": "Nonzero paired effects",
      "requirement": "Initialized actual binding preservation",
      "spec_path": "openspec/changes/operational-interface-binding-preservation/specs/global-binding-preservation/spec.md",
      "spec_line": 59,
      "spec_sha256": "b2c21cd551383b88cbd9ff807be8902ef7c71047d064bf015c6ac09fd0c36902",
      "normative_scenario": "- **WHEN** F07 executes one paired-debit receipt from A5/B5/Carol0 and its companion executes an actual M1 seq of two op102 leaves from the same entry\n- **THEN** the original case reaches4/4/2; the group prefixes reach4/4/2 then3/3/4 with independently expected full cursors, exact receipts and successful A=B queries at both prefixes, instantiating initialized group-binding preservation",
      "tasks": [
        "4.1",
        "4.3",
        "4.4",
        "5.3"
      ],
      "proof_source_refs": [
        {
          "name": "DefiKernel.Interface.step_binding_preserved",

          "path": "lean/DefiKernel/Interface/BindingPreservation.lean",
          "line": 105,
          "source_sha256": "fc8a841eabb709948d86c57d9f2fbecf60e5e7645ea33c43b6760488e5869af5",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem step_binding_preserved {cfg : Config P A D} {boundary : Boundary P A D}\n    {index : Nat} {history : List (OutputObservation A)} {step : Step P A D}\n    {pre : World P A D} {result : StepResult P A D} (edges : List Binding)\n    (initial : Agrees cfg.catalog edges pre.state)\n    (executed : executeStep cfg boundary index history step pre = .ok result)\n    (paired : EffectPaired cfg.catalog edges result.receipt) :\n    Agrees cfg.catalog edges result.world.state",
          "header_scope": "source syntax, not full elaborated theorem type or completed compiler evidence",
          "category": "generic_proof"
        },
        {
          "name": "DefiKernel.Interface.Fixtures.paired_nonzero_effects",
          "kind": "theorem",
          "path": "lean/DefiKernel/Interface/Fixtures.lean",
          "line": 55,
          "source_sha256": "93f091793683004307987260d03be8cb1fc4c7b0f07447eabde4b50a8f87c603",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem paired_nonzero_effects :\n    receiptCellEffect receipt102 alice = -1 \u2227 receiptCellEffect receipt102 bob = -1",
          "header_scope": "source syntax, not full elaborated theorem type or completed compiler evidence",
          "category": "finite_instance"
        },
        {
          "name": "DefiKernel.Interface.Fixtures.f07_local_rule",
          "kind": "theorem",
          "path": "lean/DefiKernel/Interface/Fixtures.lean",
          "line": 71,
          "source_sha256": "93f091793683004307987260d03be8cb1fc4c7b0f07447eabde4b50a8f87c603",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem f07_local_rule : LocalPreserves cfg pairedOnly (Agrees cfg.catalog edges)",
          "header_scope": "source syntax, not full elaborated theorem type or completed compiler evidence",
          "category": "finite_instance"
        },
        {
          "name": "DefiKernel.Interface.Fixtures.f07_group_initialized_preservation",
          "kind": "theorem",
          "path": "lean/DefiKernel/Interface/Fixtures.lean",
          "line": 78,
          "source_sha256": "93f091793683004307987260d03be8cb1fc4c7b0f07447eabde4b50a8f87c603",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem f07_group_initialized_preservation :\n    Agrees cfg.catalog edges\n      (Metatheory.runGroup cfg boundary initialCursor pairedGroup).world.state",
          "header_scope": "source syntax, not full elaborated theorem type or completed compiler evidence",
          "category": "finite_instance"
        }

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem bindingsHold_reverse (cfg : Config P A D) (edges : List Binding)\n    (state : State P A D) :\n    bindingsHold cfg (edges.map reverseBinding) state = true \u2194\n      bindingsHold cfg edges state = true",

          "source_sha256": "e170ec67737f94b111cfacb00bda9eae14826bb71f92d2199949634a88e8a8c0",
          "source_declaration_header": "theorem checkBindings_first_failure (cfg : Config P A D) (edges : List Binding)\n    (state : State P A D) (failure : BindingFailure P A D) :\n    checkBindings cfg edges state = .error failure \u2194\n      (validateCatalog cfg.registry cfg.catalog = false \u2227 failure = .configuration) \u2228\n      (validateCatalog cfg.registry cfg.catalog = true \u2227\n        \u2203 before edge after, edges = before ++ edge :: after \u2227\n          Agrees cfg.catalog before state \u2227\n          EdgeFailureAt cfg.catalog edge state before.length failure)",

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem interleaving_total_preserved (cfg : Config P A D) (allowed : Step P A D \u2192 Prop)\n    (region : Region P A D) (cells : Finset (Cell P A D))\n    (support : Set (Cell P A D)) (value : State P A D \u2192 \u211a)\n    (supported : ValueSupports support value)\n    (obligations : RegionObligations cfg allowed region cells support value)\n    (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D) (left right : Branch P A D)\n    (permittedLeft : \u2200 inv \u2208 left, allowed (.invoke inv))\n    (permittedRight : \u2200 inv \u2208 right, allowed (.invoke inv))\n    (entry : Interleaving.Machine P A D) (schedule : Interleaving.Schedule)\n    (initial : balanceSum region entry.world.state = value entry.world.state) :\n    balanceSum region\n        (Interleaving.continueRun cfg boundaries left right entry schedule).world.state =\n      value (Interleaving.continueRun cfg boundaries left right entry schedule).world.state",

          "category": "generic_proof"
        },

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem interleaving_prefix_typed_total_preserved (cfg : Config P A D)\n    (allowed : Step P A D \u2192 Prop) (region : Region P A D) (cells : Finset (Cell P A D))\n    (support : Set (Cell P A D)) (value : State P A D \u2192 \u211a)\n    (supported : ValueSupports support value)\n    (obligations : RegionObligations cfg allowed region cells support value)\n    (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D) (left right : Branch P A D)\n    (permittedLeft : \u2200 inv \u2208 left, allowed (.invoke inv))\n    (permittedRight : \u2200 inv \u2208 right, allowed (.invoke inv))\n    (initial : World P A D) (schedule : Interleaving.Schedule)\n    (initialized : TypedTotalContract region value initial.state) (count : Nat) :\n    TypedTotalContract region value\n      (Interleaving.runPrefix cfg boundaries initial left right\n        (schedule.take count)).world.state",

          "source_declaration_header": "theorem continueRun_accounting (region : Region P A D) (cfg : Config P A D)\n    (boundaries : Nat \u2192 Boundary P A D) (entry : Cursor P A D) (steps : List (Step P A D)) :\n    balanceSum region (Composition.continueRun cfg boundaries entry steps).world.state =\n      balanceSum region entry.world.state + eventDeltaSum region\n        ((Composition.continueRun cfg boundaries entry steps).events.drop entry.events.length)",
